menu.name: Chicken Biriyani
menu.description: Classic Royal Dum Biryani infused with whole cardamom, cloves, succulent chicken cuts, served with raita and gravy.

menu.name: Mutton Biriyani
menu.description: Tender goat meat slow-simmered with aromatic saffron rice, rose water, and royal Awadhi spices.

menu.name: Egg Biriyani
menu.description: Aromatic basmati rice layered with crispy golden-fried spiced eggs and caramelized onions.

menu.name: Veg Dum Biriyani
menu.description: Fresh garden vegetables, soft paneer cubes, and aromatic whole spices cooked in aged basmati rice.

menu.name: Special Egg Devil (2 Pcs)
menu.description: Crispy Bengali & Assamese style spiced mashed potato croquettes stuffed with seasoned boiled eggs.

menu.name: Jonak Chicken Maharaja

menu.name: Chicken Maharani

menu.name: Chicken Drumsticks (Tangdi Kabab)

menu.name: Crispy KFC Style Chicken Bucket

menu.name: Golden Chicken Fingers

menu.name: Chicken Cutlet

menu.name: Chicken Dry Fry

menu.name: Chicken Pakoda

menu.name: Chicken Salted Pepper

menu.name: Paneer Pakoda

rooms.title: Suite Room (A/C)
rooms.description: Jonak Hotel's most prestigious accommodations (Rooms 101 & 102). Features expansive bedrooms, private living lounge, plush furnishings, and personalized hospitality for dignitaries and wedding VIPs.

rooms.title: Twin Room (A/C)
rooms.description: Spacious twin-bedded sanctuary (Room 204) designed for business colleagues, friends, or traveling family members seeking separate premium beds with full air-conditioned comfort.

rooms.title: Twin Room (Non-A/C)
rooms.description: Bright, airy 3rd-floor room (Room 303) featuring large windows with natural cross-ventilation, comfortable twin beds, and complete hotel services without air conditioning.

rooms.title: Deluxe Room (A/C)
amenities: HD Smart TV with Cable Channels
rooms.description: Our most sought-after category (Rooms 201, 203, 301). Perfect for couples and business executives needing a polished, peaceful AC room near Barpeta's commercial hub.

rooms.title: Single Room (A/C)
rooms.description: Tailored specifically for solo executives, medical representatives, and lone travelers (Room 202). Compact, ultra-clean, and fully air-conditioned for a restful night.

rooms.title: Single Room (Non-A/C)
rooms.description: Jonak Hotel's most economical stay (Rooms 302, 304). Spotlessly clean, peaceful non-AC rooms offering unbeatable value with full access to restaurant dining.
